scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace packages/protocol && concurrently -n SERVER,WEB -c magenta,green "npm run dev --workspace apps/server" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.dev:account: npm run build --workspace packages/protocol && concurrently -n SERVER,WEB -c magenta,green "node --env-file=.env.qq-smtp.local node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs watch apps/server/src/index.ts" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace packages/protocol && npm run build --workspace apps/server && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace packages/protocol && npm run test --workspace apps/server && npm run test --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace packages/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/server && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
